agent.problem: The earlier cards only say that the LORD raised up Othniel as deliverer. They give no basis for choosing "Spirit" over "hand" or "fear," so the blank asks for the unseen wording of the BSB phrase rather than a meaning the baker can reason out.

rule.text: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.

agent.problem: Seven of the ten choice cards are multiple choice, compared with two fill-in-the-blank cards and one true-or-false card. Multiple choice therefore dominates the stop by a wide margin.

rule.text: No stop repeats another stop's pattern, and no type dominates a stop by a wide margin.

human.problem: This joke reuses the template from stop 1 card 8 almost word for word.
